items.title: Boarding pass over a map - YBI to YAY with barcode
items.description: A dark boarding pass card over an Apple Maps coast: YBI (Black Tickle) → YAY (St Anthony), Seat 61C, 33m, Distance 232 km, Boarding Now, Date 2026/09/20, and a scannable barcode strip. A flight-pass reveal.

items.title: Sticker-bubble onboarding with a press circle and social buttons
items.description: A held phone on a pink screen: floating sticker bubbles cascade toward a white press circle under 'Meet the... software...' copy, with Continue with Google / Continue with Apple buttons. A playful onboarding moment.

items.title: 'Cozy Crowd' - share a theme strip with a friend
items.description: A held phone: 'Share a little cozy' over an animal-sticker collage card 'Cozy Crowd - Six playful themes, free for a friend to try', with a barcode and 'Tap or pull a strip from either side to share an invitation'. A gift-a-theme invite, not a profile feed.

items.title: Vybe onboarding - 'Vybe according to your interests'
items.description: A dark onboarding step: 'Vybe according to your interests:' with chips (Fitness, Lookingsharp, Peoples), dimmed 'Get Healthy Vybe' / 'Mapper Vybe' cards, a white Join button and 'Skip and start fresh'. Same screen as VID-0284.

items.title: Vybe onboarding - the same interests step, second clip
items.description: The identical dark 'Vybe according to your interests:' step (Fitness/Lookingsharp/Peoples chips, Get Healthy Vybe card, Join, Skip and start fresh) captured again. A duplicate of VID-0208 in the Vybe set.

items.title: Game collection page - Zelda: The Wind Waker (GameCube)
items.description: A collection detail: 'The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker' with ゼルダの伝説 風のタクト, Share/Add/Edit, Owned by You, For the GameCube, Region NTSC-J, Condition Complete-in-box, Year 2002 and an 'About the game' screenshot. A game-library page.

items.title: Podcast onboarding - Trending episodes and top podcasts
items.description: A dark onboarding: a phone-in-phone showing 'Trending Episodes' (Hard Fork) and 'Top Podcasts' (Acquired, Tomorrow Today) under 'Trending - See what listeners are tuning into right now', with Continue and Skip. A podcast discovery step, not a music playlist.

items.title: Apple Account password sheet over a dark app
items.description: A dark 'Apple Account' sheet: 'Enter the password for Apple Account ex23jr@gmail.com to continue', a masked field, Next, Forgot Password and a keyboard with a Passwords row. A system auth moment, not a welcome screen.

items.title: 62% September - a dot-grid progress on black
items.description: A black screen reading '62% September' with a filling dot-grid glyph and Year/Month pills bottom-left, % chip bottom-right. A stark progress/stat moment.

items.title: Sundrop Collections - processing photos with partial results
items.description: A light 'Collections' screen: colour-dot logo, 'Collections will be ready when photo processing finishes', 'Processing photos 2,418 of 6,240 - Fastest with Sundrop open', and Favorites/Special Moments cards. A photo-organiser processing state.

items.title: Sundrop - 'How spouse sharing works' explainer sheet
items.description: 'Sundrop' home (Next drop in 10:35:39, family photo grid) behind a white sheet 'How spouse sharing works': best family photos both ways, Saved to Apple Photos, Syncs through iCloud. A sharing explainer, not episodic sharing.

items.title: 'Autofill Transactions' - Pixel Budget Tracker with expense keypad
items.description: A labelled clip: 'Autofill Transactions' over a 'Pixel Budget Tracker' (Balance $16,592.59, $3,550.00, $2,140.69) with a white '250 New expense' sheet (Category Dana-Groceries, Account Dana-Main checking, Note, Groceries) and a keypad. An autofill demo.

items.title: Side Quests - 'Build the path to a Green Card' gamified list
items.description: A soft screen with a 'SILENT - Build the path to a Green Card' hero card, 'Side Quests' list (ACTIVE: Understand the AI you design for, Read the walls) and Today/Quests/Memory tabs. A gamified career-journey app.

items.title: Skin-type picker - 'What's your skin type?' Type III
items.description: 'What's your skin type? This helps us customize optimal sun exposure' with a hex swatch carousel (Type III 'Fair to medium, sometimes burns'), arrows, black Continue and Back. Same screen as VID-0171.

items.title: Skin-type picker - duplicate clip of the Type III step
items.description: The identical 'What's your skin type?' Type III hex-swatch step with Continue/Back, captured again. Duplicate of VID-0172 in the sun-exposure onboarding.

items.title: 'Create poll' - 'A gallery of' with sticker row and keyboard
items.description: A web-view 'Create poll' screen typing 'A gallery of' with a sticker/emoji row (calendar, shirt, book) above an iOS keyboard and a blue Create pool button. A poll-composing moment.

items.title: Signup - 'Enter your name' with an iOS keyboard
items.description: A clean signup step: 'Enter your name - This is how you'll appear to others', an empty Name field and a disabled Next over the iOS keyboard. A name-entry moment.

items.title: Sudoku onboarding - 'Select your level' with Hard chosen
items.description: A white onboarding with a tiny sudoku logo: 'Select your level - You can change this at any time', options Easy/Medium/Hard (red, selected, 'Advanced techniques needed. Taxes strategic thinking.')/Expert/Master and a black Continue. A difficulty picker.

items.title: AI chat - 'Hi Raffi, ask anything' with a Chat History sheet
items.description: A blurred 'Hi Raffi, ask anything' chat behind a white 'Chat History' sheet listing Today threads (Untitled thread, New chat x2 with snippets) and a search field. A history drawer, not a document reader.

items.title: ProDex - a colourful Pokédex companion home
items.description: A 'ProDex' home: red Pokédex banner, tiles for Moves (yellow), TM (green), Teams (blue pokeball), Locations (purple), plus Abilities/Checklists chips and rows (Type Chart, Gym Leaders & Elite 4, Items). A Pokémon companion, not a plain list.

items.title: Reward reveal - 'You earned 12 gems!' on black
items.description: A black screen with a blue gem-card glyph '12', 'You earned 12 gems!' and a blue CONTINUE button. A reward moment, not a splash.

items.title: Japanese lyric card on a soft dot grid
items.description: A lavender card reading 'この夢が残してくれたのは 悲しみという気持ち' over a dotted field with a small orb cluster. A quiet lyric/quote moment.

items.title: Bare home - empty content with a blue pill bottom nav
items.description: A near-empty white screen whose only chrome is a floating bottom nav (blue Home pill, search, bookmark, profile). An empty-state shell.

items.title: September 2026 date picker - 16 selected, 23 marked
items.description: A light 'September 2026' month sheet with chevrons, the 16th filled blue, the 23rd dotted, and Today/Done buttons. A date-picker moment.

items.title: 'Before photographs' - vintage travel-poster collage story
items.description: A collage of vintage travel posters (ski slope, beach palm, ocean liner, skyline, concorde) under 'Before photographs - Travel ads used to be paintings', with share/like/layout/hide bubbles. An editorial poster story, not a rearrange tool.

items.title: Paper toss - crumpled ball and bin with pull-to-aim
items.description: A white screen with a wire bin, a crumpled paper ball and 'Pull down to aim your toss' hint - a paper-toss game interaction, not an AI undo prompt.

items.title: Privacy onboarding - 'Your moments stay private' lock sheet
items.description: A dark flow: a loading screen (Sep 24, Thu) then a white sheet with a lock glyph, 'Your moments stay private - We never keep your photos. They're only used to draw your doodle.' and Got it. A privacy reassurance step.

items.title: Habit tracker - DAY 14/28 with an empty goals state
items.description: A dark tracker in an iPhone 17 Pro Max frame: FEBRUARY 2026, 'DAY 14 / 28', week strip with the 14th lifted, and GOALS showing 'No goals for this day - Add a goal to get started!'. An empty-day state.

items.title: COMPOSE - a dark green numbered item list
items.description: A dark-green screen titled 'COMPOSE' with a long ruled list (Item 7-Item 20). A sparse list moment, likely a writing/composition tool.

items.title: Class schedule - blue September week with biology cards
items.description: A dark-blue 'Schedule' with a September chip, week strip (12 selected), and class cards: 'Human Anatomy and Physiology - Dr. Emily Carter, Biology Lab Room B2, 8:00-8:45 AM' (checked) and 'Advanced Studies in Biology - 9:00-10:45 AM', under a theme toggle. A student timetable, not notifications.

items.title: Warm timer - '15h 00m' with a day ruler and Start fast
items.description: A tilted warm-gradient screen: '15h 00m' countdown, a Custom chip, 'Start fast' button, an orange-ticked time ruler (now/6AM/12PM) and a round icon dock. A focus/sleep timer home.

items.title: Proxima A assistant - prompt list with Help/Activity/Settings
items.description: A dark assistant screen with prompt rows ('(a+b)^2=?', 'What is the fastest car in the world?', 'Write an essay on Artificial Intellig...'), Help/Activity/Settings and 'Say Hello to Proxima A*' input. An AI assistant home.

items.title: Payment received - ₱500.00 receipt sheet with Done
items.description: A dark sheet: green check, 'Payment received - Your payment of ₱500.00 was completed successfully.', Receipt no. ADMR/2026/812, Cleared 'Other fee, teaching fee etc.', Timestamp 14 Sep 2026 8:41 AM, blue Done. A receipt moment, not a context menu.

items.title: 'forget him' - josh conway player held over a snow field
items.description: A design-tool frame showing a held phone: 'forget him - josh conway' over a photo of a person seated in snow, waveform, big pause controls and 'Playing from Discovery Station'. A player-in-context shot.

items.title: Photo burn - a lighter torches the selected polaroid
items.description: A grey screen where a raccoon-branded lighter burns a torn polaroid while other photo scraps wait, with close and red trash buttons - a burn-to-delete metaphor.

items.title: Tasks and Notes - strikethrough tasks and sticky notes
items.description: A light 'Tasks' card (10 task not started: design system, mobile design, interaction motion with dates) above a 'Notes' card with two sticky notes ('please use cloud to generate', 'explain thing to Farzad'). A productivity home.
